rankedLeadSummary: 1. Ribé & Roll Dann — Ars Non Placens: hunched drums and dubby undercurrents as a subtle early deepener.
2. Gerald Cleaver, Hprizm & Brandon Lopez — Rama: concise polyrhythm assembly followed by a sudden pitch-down.
3. Nueen — Copicat: slow ratcheting hi-hats culminating in a singular heavy arrival.
4. Bitchin Bajas — Ajami: a sixteen-minute 6/8 transformation returning to 4/4 motorik motion.
5. Ribé & Roll Dann — Extra Lumen: restrained steady force as early continuation.
6. Gerald Cleaver, Hprizm & Brandon Lopez — Hopoff: muddy syncopation and marching thumps.
7. Ribé & Roll Dann — Sub Terra: direct physical club-tool continuity.
8. Gerald Cleaver, Hprizm & Brandon Lopez — Blowback: toy-like dialogue displaced by a central rhythm.
9. Bitchin Bajas — Isle Peaks: freeform field-sound and drone prelude ending in a pitch dive.
